claims.statement: The Derby headquarters site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

claims.quote: a railway that often lets them down
claims.statement: People have for too long put up with a railway that often lets them down.

claims.quote: I’m delighted Becketwell will become GBR’s new home
claims.statement: Becketwell will become Great British Railways' new home.

claims.quote: This forms part of our £2.5 billion youth employment support package which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of Great British Railways' headquarters was unveiled in Derby.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Rail fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network
facts.statement: 76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the rail network.

facts.statement: There has been a recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north, to be built at Alstom's Derby site.

facts.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.
